title: Extended-Marketing Allowance on Short Sales — Payoff and Loan Satisfaction
content:
Extended-marketing allowance — Payoff and Loan Satisfaction

**Clause.** On the payoff case of an Approved Short Sale Payoff requested by the borrower of record, the extended-marketing allowance is one of the amounts paid from the price at closing. It is 0.75 percent of the contract price when the contract's listing date is at least 180 calendar days before its request date, and 0.5 percent when it is at least 90 but fewer than 180 calendar days before it, rounded half up to the cent; a contract with a shorter listing, or with no listing date, carries nothing (0.00). The contract is the purchase contract submission on file for the case whose request status is received.

| Calendar days from the listing date to the contract's request date | Allowance |
|---|---|
| 180 or more | 0.75 percent of the contract price |
| 90 to 179 | 0.5 percent of the contract price |
| fewer than 90, or no listing date | nothing |

**Hypothetical:** a USD 350000.00 contract submitted 200 days after listing earns USD 2625.00; submitted 120 days after listing, USD 1750.00; submitted 89 days after listing, nothing; submitted exactly 90 days after listing, USD 1750.00.
